questions.scenario:
The flow chart shows how the water level of the blood is regulated.
Water level in the blood drops below normal → detected by receptors in the hypothalamus → pituitary gland secretes more hormone X → the walls of the collecting ducts become more permeable → more water is reabsorbed → water level returns to normal
questions.scenarioAf:
Die vloeidiagram toon hoe die watervlak van die bloed gereguleer word.
Watervlak in die bloed daal onder normaal → waargeneem deur reseptore in die hipotalamus → pituïtêre klier skei meer hormoon X af → die wande van die versamelbuise word meer deurlaatbaar → meer water word herabsorbeer → watervlak keer terug na normaal

questions.q: Name hormone X.
questions.qAf: Noem hormoon X.
points: ADH (antidiuretic hormone)
pointsAf: ADH (antidiuretiese hormoon)

questions.q: Name the organ on which hormone X acts.
questions.qAf: Noem die orgaan waarop hormoon X inwerk.
points: kidney
pointsAf: nier

questions.q: Name the type of mechanism shown in the flow chart.
questions.qAf: Noem die soort meganisme wat in die vloeidiagram getoon word.
points: negative feedback
pointsAf: negatiewe terugvoer

questions.q: Describe how the body responds when the water level of the blood rises above normal.
questions.qAf: Beskryf hoe die liggaam reageer wanneer die watervlak van die bloed bo normaal styg.
points: The pituitary gland secretes less ADH
the collecting ducts become less permeable to water
less water is reabsorbed and a large volume of dilute urine is produced
pointsAf: Die pituïtêre klier skei minder ADH af
die versamelbuise word minder deurlaatbaar vir water
minder water word herabsorbeer en ’n groot volume verdunde urine word geproduseer

questions.q: Alcohol inhibits the secretion of hormone X. Explain why drinking a lot of alcohol can cause dehydration.
questions.qAf: Alkohol inhibeer die afskeiding van hormoon X. Verduidelik waarom die drink van baie alkohol dehidrasie kan veroorsaak.
points: Less ADH is secreted
so less water is reabsorbed in the collecting ducts
a large volume of urine is lost and the body loses too much water
pointsAf: Minder ADH word afgeskei
dus word minder water in die versamelbuise herabsorbeer
’n groot volume urine gaan verlore en die liggaam verloor te veel water

questions.scenario: Learners measured their reaction times by catching a falling ruler, before and 30 minutes after drinking a cup of strong coffee. The table shows the results.
questions.scenarioAf: Leerders het hul reaksietye gemeet deur ’n vallende liniaal te vang, voor en 30 minute nadat hulle ’n koppie sterk koffie gedrink het. Die tabel toon die resultate.

questions.q: Identify the dependent variable.
questions.qAf: Identifiseer die afhanklike veranderlike.
points: reaction time
pointsAf: reaksietyd

questions.q: Calculate the average reaction time before drinking coffee.
questions.qAf: Bereken die gemiddelde reaksietyd voordat koffie gedrink is.

questions.q: State a conclusion for this investigation.
questions.qAf: Stel ’n gevolgtrekking vir hierdie ondersoek.
points: Drinking coffee (caffeine) decreases the reaction time
the average after coffee (216 ms) is lower than before (250 ms)
pointsAf: Die drink van koffie (kafeïen) verkort die reaksietyd
die gemiddeld ná koffie (216 ms) is laer as voor (250 ms)

questions.q: Give TWO ways in which the learners could make their results more reliable.
questions.qAf: Gee TWEE maniere waarop die leerders hul resultate meer betroubaar kon maak.
points: Use more learners (a larger sample)
repeat each measurement several times and calculate an average
pointsAf: Gebruik meer leerders (’n groter steekproef)
herhaal elke meting ’n paar keer en bereken ’n gemiddeld

questions.q: Catching the ruler is not a reflex action. Explain why it takes longer than a reflex.
questions.qAf: Om die liniaal te vang, is nie ’n refleksaksie nie. Verduidelik waarom dit langer as ’n refleks neem.
points: It is a voluntary action
the impulse must travel to the brain (cerebrum), where a decision is made
the pathway is longer and has more synapses than a reflex arc through the spinal cord
pointsAf: Dit is ’n willekeurige aksie
die impuls moet na die brein (serebrum) beweeg, waar ’n besluit geneem word
die pad is langer en het meer sinapse as ’n refleksboog deur die rugmurg

questions.scenario: The table shows the thickness of the endometrium of a woman during a 28-day menstrual cycle.
questions.scenarioAf: Die tabel toon die dikte van die endometrium van ’n vrou gedurende ’n menstruele siklus van 28 dae.

questions.q: Name the hormone that causes the endometrium to thicken between day 5 and day 14.
questions.qAf: Noem die hormoon wat die endometrium tussen dag 5 en dag 14 laat verdik.
points: oestrogen
pointsAf: estrogeen

questions.q: What happens to the endometrium between day 1 and day 5?
questions.qAf: Wat gebeur met die endometrium tussen dag 1 en dag 5?
points: It breaks down and is lost (menstruation)
pointsAf: Dit breek af en gaan verlore (menstruasie)

questions.q: Name the hormone that keeps the endometrium thick after ovulation.
questions.qAf: Noem die hormoon wat die endometrium ná ovulasie dik hou.
points: progesterone
pointsAf: progesteroon

questions.q: Explain why the endometrium becomes thinner after day 21.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik waarom die endometrium ná dag 21 dunner word.
points: Fertilisation did not take place
the corpus luteum degenerates
so the progesterone level drops and the endometrium is no longer maintained
pointsAf: Bevrugting het nie plaasgevind nie
die corpus luteum degenereer
dus daal die progesteroonvlak en die endometrium word nie meer in stand gehou nie

questions.q: Explain how the thickness of the endometrium on day 28 would differ if fertilisation had taken place.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik hoe die dikte van die endometrium op dag 28 sou verskil as bevrugting plaasgevind het.
points: It would stay thick
the corpus luteum (and later the placenta) keeps secreting progesterone
so the endometrium is maintained for implantation of the embryo
pointsAf: Dit sou dik bly
die corpus luteum (en later die plasenta) hou aan om progesteroon af te skei
dus word die endometrium in stand gehou vir die innesteling van die embrio

questions.scenario: The table compares the reproductive strategies of three animals.
questions.scenarioAf: Die tabel vergelyk die voortplantingstrategieë van drie diere.

questions.q: Explain why internal fertilisation increases the chance that fertilisation takes place.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik waarom inwendige bevrugting die kans verhoog dat bevrugting plaasvind.
points: Sperm are deposited close to the egg
the gametes are protected from drying out and from predators
pointsAf: Sperms word naby die eiersel gedeponeer
die gamete word teen uitdroging en roofdiere beskerm

questions.q: Ostrich chicks are precocial. Explain what this means and give ONE advantage.
questions.qAf: Volstruiskuikens is prekosiaal. Verduidelik wat dit beteken en gee EEN voordeel.
points: The young can see, move and feed themselves soon after hatching
they can escape from predators / need less parental care
pointsAf: Die kleintjies kan kort ná uitbroei sien, beweeg en self eet
hulle kan van roofdiere ontsnap / het minder ouersorg nodig

questions.q: Explain why humans can survive as a species while producing very few offspring.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik waarom mense as spesie kan oorleef terwyl hulle baie min nakomelinge produseer.
points: Each baby gets a lot of parental care
so the chance that each offspring survives to adulthood is high
pointsAf: Elke baba kry baie ouersorg
dus is die kans hoog dat elke nakomeling tot volwassenheid oorleef

questions.q: Which animal in the table shows ovovivipary?
questions.qAf: Watter dier in die tabel toon ovoviviparie?
points: shark

questions.q: Where in the female reproductive system does implantation take place?
questions.qAf: Waar in die vroulike voortplantingstelsel vind innesteling plaas?
points: in the endometrium (wall) of the uterus
pointsAf: in die endometrium (wand) van die uterus

questions.q: Describe THREE functions of the amniotic fluid.
questions.qAf: Beskryf DRIE funksies van die vrugwater.
points: acts as a shock absorber that protects the foetus
prevents the foetus from drying out
allows the foetus to move freely / keeps the temperature constant
pointsAf: dien as skokbreker wat die fetus beskerm
voorkom dat die fetus uitdroog
laat die fetus toe om vrylik te beweeg / hou die temperatuur konstant

questions.q: Explain how the combined contraceptive pill (oestrogen and progesterone) prevents pregnancy.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik hoe die gekombineerde voorbehoedpil (estrogeen en progesteroon) swangerskap voorkom.
points: The hormones inhibit the secretion of FSH (and LH)
so no follicle develops and no ovulation takes place
pointsAf: Die hormone inhibeer die afskeiding van FSH (en LH)
dus ontwikkel geen follikel nie en geen ovulasie vind plaas nie

questions.q: Name the hormone responsible for the male secondary sexual characteristics.
questions.qAf: Noem die hormoon wat vir die manlike sekondêre geslagseienskappe verantwoordelik is.
points: testosterone
pointsAf: testosteroon

questions.q: Describe the path that sperm follow from where they are produced until they leave the body.
questions.qAf: Beskryf die pad wat sperms volg vanaf waar hulle geproduseer word totdat hulle die liggaam verlaat.
points: produced in the seminiferous tubules of the testes
stored and matured in the epididymis
move through the vas deferens (sperm duct)
fluids are added by the seminal vesicles, prostate gland and Cowper’s glands
leave the body through the urethra in the penis
pointsAf: geproduseer in die saadbuisies van die testes
gestoor en ryp gemaak in die epididimis
beweeg deur die vas deferens (saadbuis)
vloeistowwe word deur die saadblasies, prostaatklier en Cowper-kliere bygevoeg
verlaat die liggaam deur die uretra in die penis

questions.q: Explain TWO ways in which a sperm cell is adapted for its function.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik TWEE maniere waarop ’n spermsel by sy funksie aangepas is.
points: a tail (flagellum) to swim to the ovum
an acrosome with enzymes to dissolve a way into the ovum / many mitochondria to release energy
pointsAf: ’n stert (flagellum) om na die ovum te swem
’n akrosoom met ensieme om ’n pad in die ovum oop te los / baie mitochondria om energie vry te stel

questions.scenario: Gamete formation and the female reproductive system.

questions.q: Describe the process of spermatogenesis.
questions.qAf: Beskryf die proses van spermatogenese.
points: Under the influence of testosterone
diploid cells in the seminiferous tubules divide by mitosis
some of these cells undergo meiosis
to form haploid spermatids
which mature into sperm cells
pointsAf: Onder die invloed van testosteroon
deel diploïede selle in die saadbuisies deur mitose
sommige van hierdie selle ondergaan meiose
om haploïede spermatiede te vorm
wat tot spermselle ryp word

questions.q: Draw a labelled diagram of the human female reproductive system (front view).
questions.qAf: Teken ’n benoemde diagram van die menslike vroulike voortplantingstelsel (vooraansig).
points: correct drawing, with any FOUR correct labels: ovary, Fallopian tube (oviduct), uterus, cervix, vagina
pointsAf: korrekte tekening, met enige VIER korrekte byskrifte: ovarium, Fallopiusbuis (eierleier), uterus, serviks, vagina

sections.title: The nervous system and the senses

questions.scenario: A doctor taps a patient just below the knee and the lower leg kicks forward at once.
questions.scenarioAf: ’n Dokter tik ’n pasiënt net onder die knie en die onderbeen skop dadelik vorentoe.

questions.q: Name this type of response.
questions.qAf: Noem hierdie soort reaksie.
points: reflex action
pointsAf: refleksaksie

questions.q: Name the part of the central nervous system that coordinates this response.
questions.qAf: Noem die deel van die sentrale senuweestelsel wat hierdie reaksie koördineer.
points: spinal cord
pointsAf: rugmurg

questions.q: Explain why doctors test this response.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik waarom dokters hierdie reaksie toets.
points: To check that the nerve pathway (neurons and spinal cord) works normally
an absent or weak response shows damage somewhere in the reflex arc
pointsAf: Om te kontroleer of die senuweebaan (neurone en rugmurg) normaal werk
’n afwesige of swak reaksie wys skade iewers in die refleksboog

questions.q: Explain the role of a synapse in a reflex arc.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik die rol van ’n sinaps in ’n refleksboog.
points: It ensures that the impulse travels in one direction only
by means of a neurotransmitter that crosses the gap to the next neuron
pointsAf: Dit verseker dat die impuls net in een rigting beweeg
deur middel van ’n neuro-oordragstof wat oor die spleet na die volgende neuron beweeg

questions.q: A drug blocks the synapses in the spinal cord. Predict the effect on this response. Explain.
questions.qAf: ’n Middel blokkeer die sinapse in die rugmurg. Voorspel die uitwerking op hierdie reaksie. Verduidelik.
points: The leg will not kick (no response)
the impulse cannot pass from the sensory neuron to the motor neuron
pointsAf: Die been sal nie skop nie (geen reaksie)
die impuls kan nie van die sensoriese neuron na die motoriese neuron oorgaan nie

questions.scenario: A learner looks at a bus in the distance and then reads a book.
questions.scenarioAf: ’n Leerder kyk na ’n bus in die verte en lees dan ’n boek.

questions.q: Describe how the eye adjusts to see the book clearly.
questions.qAf: Beskryf hoe die oog aanpas om die boek duidelik te sien.
points: The ciliary muscles contract
the suspensory ligaments slacken
the lens becomes more convex (rounder)
light is refracted more and focused on the retina
pointsAf: Die siliêre spiere trek saam
die ophangligamente verslap
die lens word meer konveks (ronder)
lig word meer gebreek en op die retina gefokus

questions.q: Many people over 45 need reading glasses because the lens loses its elasticity. Name this condition and the type of lens used to correct it.
questions.qAf: Baie mense ouer as 45 het leesbrille nodig omdat die lens sy elastisiteit verloor. Noem hierdie toestand en die soort lens wat gebruik word om dit reg te stel.
points: presbyopia
convex (converging) lens
pointsAf: presbiopie
konvekse (konvergerende) lens

questions.q: Explain why an image that falls on the blind spot is not seen.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik waarom ’n beeld wat op die blindekol val, nie gesien word nie.
points: The blind spot has no rods or cones (photoreceptors)
so no impulses are generated
pointsAf: Die blindekol het geen stafies of keëltjies (fotoreseptore) nie
dus word geen impulse gegenereer nie

questions.q: Name the type of control mechanism that keeps the body temperature constant.
questions.qAf: Noem die soort beheermeganisme wat die liggaamstemperatuur konstant hou.
points: negative feedback
pointsAf: negatiewe terugvoer

questions.q: Describe how the body responds when the body temperature drops below normal.
questions.qAf: Beskryf hoe die liggaam reageer wanneer die liggaamstemperatuur onder normaal daal.
points: The hypothalamus detects the drop
blood vessels in the skin constrict (vasoconstriction)
less blood flows near the skin surface, so less heat is lost
sweat glands become less active, so less heat is lost by evaporation
shivering (muscle contractions) produces heat
pointsAf: Die hipotalamus neem die daling waar
bloedvate in die vel vernou (vasokonstriksie)
minder bloed vloei naby die veloppervlak, dus gaan minder hitte verlore
sweetkliere word minder aktief, dus gaan minder hitte deur verdamping verlore
bewe (spiersametrekkings) produseer hitte

questions.scenario: Learners investigated the response of bean seedlings to gravity, in the dark.
questions.scenarioAf: Leerders het die reaksie van boontjiesaailinge op swaartekrag in die donker ondersoek.

questions.q: Identify the independent variable.
questions.qAf: Identifiseer die onafhanklike veranderlike.
points: whether gravity acts on one side of the seedling (still or rotated)
pointsAf: of swaartekrag op een kant van die saailing inwerk (stil of gedraai)

questions.q: State a hypothesis for this investigation.
questions.qAf: Stel ’n hipotese vir hierdie ondersoek.
points: Roots grow towards gravity and shoots grow away from gravity
(a testable statement that links gravity to the direction of growth)
pointsAf: Wortels groei na swaartekrag toe en lote groei weg van swaartekrag
(’n toetsbare stelling wat swaartekrag met die groeirigting verbind)

questions.q: Explain the result for the root in group A.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik die resultaat vir die wortel in groep A.
points: Auxins collect on the lower side of the root because of gravity
in roots a high auxin concentration inhibits cell elongation
the upper side grows faster, so the root bends downwards
pointsAf: Ouksiene versamel weens swaartekrag aan die onderkant van die wortel
in wortels inhibeer ’n hoë ouksienkonsentrasie selverlenging
die bokant groei vinniger, dus buig die wortel afwaarts

questions.q: Explain why group B was included in the investigation.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik waarom groep B by die ondersoek ingesluit is.
points: It is the control: the rotation lets gravity act equally on all sides
so the auxins are evenly spread and no bending takes place
pointsAf: Dit is die kontrole: die rotasie laat swaartekrag ewe veel op alle kante inwerk
dus is die ouksiene eweredig versprei en geen buiging vind plaas nie

questions.q: Explain the role of the ossicles in hearing.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik die rol van die gehoorbeentjies in hoor.
points: They carry vibrations from the tympanic membrane
to the oval window
and amplify the vibrations
pointsAf: Hulle dra vibrasies vanaf die timpaniese membraan
na die ovaal venster
en versterk die vibrasies

questions.q: Describe how the maculae in the utriculus and sacculus detect the position of the head.
questions.qAf: Beskryf hoe die makulae in die utrikulus en sakkulus die posisie van die kop waarneem.
points: When the position of the head changes
gravity pulls on the jelly (with otoliths) of the maculae
the sensory hair cells are stimulated and generate impulses
which are carried by the auditory nerve to the cerebellum
pointsAf: Wanneer die posisie van die kop verander
trek swaartekrag aan die jellie (met otoliete) van die makulae
die sensoriese haarselle word gestimuleer en genereer impulse
wat deur die gehoorsenuwee na die serebellum gedra word

questions.q: A person has damaged hair cells in the cochlea. Explain why a hearing aid will not help but a cochlear implant may.
questions.qAf: ’n Persoon het beskadigde haarselle in die koglea. Verduidelik waarom ’n gehoorapparaat nie sal help nie, maar ’n kogleêre inplanting dalk wel.
points: The damaged hair cells cannot convert vibrations into impulses
a hearing aid only makes sounds louder
a cochlear implant stimulates the auditory nerve directly
pointsAf: Die beskadigde haarselle kan nie vibrasies in impulse omsit nie
’n gehoorapparaat maak klanke net harder
’n kogleêre inplanting stimuleer die gehoorsenuwee direk

questions.q:
Describe how the human eye adjusts to see near and distant objects clearly and how the pupil responds to changes in light intensity, and explain how the body keeps the blood glucose level constant.
Content: 17 Synthesis: 3
NOTE: NO marks will be awarded for answers in the form of flow charts, tables or diagrams.
questions.qAf:
Beskryf hoe die menslike oog aanpas om naby en ver voorwerpe duidelik te sien en hoe die pupil op veranderinge in ligintensiteit reageer, en verduidelik hoe die liggaam die bloedglukosevlak konstant hou.
Inhoud: 17 Sintese: 3
LET WEL: GEEN punte sal toegeken word vir antwoorde in die vorm van vloeidiagramme, tabelle of diagramme nie.
points:
Near vision (max 9 for the eye)
The ciliary muscles contract
the suspensory ligaments slacken
the lens becomes more convex
light is refracted more
and focused on the retina
Distant vision: the ciliary muscles relax
the suspensory ligaments become taut
the lens becomes flatter / less convex
Bright light: the circular muscles of the iris contract and the radial muscles relax
the pupil becomes smaller, so less light enters
Dim light: the radial muscles contract and the circular muscles relax
the pupil becomes larger, so more light enters

Blood glucose (max 8)
When the glucose level rises, the islets of Langerhans in the pancreas
secrete insulin
insulin causes the liver and muscles to change glucose into glycogen
and cells to take up more glucose
so the glucose level drops to normal
When the glucose level drops, the pancreas secretes glucagon
glucagon causes the liver to change glycogen into glucose
so the glucose level rises to normal
This is an example of negative feedback
pointsAf:
Naby sig (maks 9 vir die oog)
Die siliêre spiere trek saam
die ophangligamente verslap
die lens word meer konveks
lig word meer gebreek
en op die retina gefokus
Ver sig: die siliêre spiere ontspan
die ophangligamente word styf
die lens word platter / minder konveks
Helder lig: die sirkelspiere van die iris trek saam en die radiale spiere ontspan
die pupil word kleiner, dus kom minder lig in
Dowwe lig: die radiale spiere trek saam en die sirkelspiere ontspan
die pupil word groter, dus kom meer lig in

Bloedglukose (maks 8)
Wanneer die glukosevlak styg, skei die eilande van Langerhans in die pankreas
insulien af
insulien laat die lewer en spiere glukose in glikogeen omsit
